objective.title: Close the actual normalized auxiliary differential estimate
objective.statement: Prove the reviewed differential inequality for F=S/R-eta R^2+(84+60eta)U from actual flow evolution, with the variable mean-scalar term retained on the left. No supplied derivative inequalities or added geometric estimates may replace those producers.

stop_conditions: Complete only when the exact target and all scoped commands pass.
If blocked retain the exact resisting Lean type, attempts and strongest verified partial; do not commit unfinished source.
No weakening, supplied derivative bounds, dropped normalization term, full build, root editing, acceptance, merge or service changes.
